text_block_list.text:
Sometime before the upcoming Selection
Race――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ……Huuu, self-assessment finished.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If I can keep it up like this,
I might get a recommendation to a sports 
university. That's how it feels.
It should be enough to meet expectations~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. If I study like this,
get in to a sports university, 
and work at a sports-related company,
I can have a stable life.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even if I choose this route,
I think even the people back 
home would praise me. I mean,
it's still a commendable future, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But, if I choose to debut in the Twinkle
Series…… 
once I go there,
there will be no turning back.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
From then on I'll be in the world of 『Serious
Uma Musume』, won't I? 
Dedicating their entire life to racing……
remarkable girls.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I don't really have the resolve to
dedicate 
my life to racing. Not at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But earlier,
when I was competing with Top Road-chan……
when it seemed like a close match,
I started to think maaaay~be I can do it
too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because of that I'm just a liiiiiii~ttle
bit concerned. 
Wondering what I should do. From now on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well,
I guess~……if it seemed like I'd do well I
thought 
it'd be okay. Do my best, run,
and being happy would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah~……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ……………Yeah. ……Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ueeh?
choice_data_list: From now on, always, more than any...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: O-oooooh……um, well~……
choice_data_list: Expectations, and I want to believe

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-you'd go that far, huh~…… 
Ah~, Waa~, Oooh~, fine I get it……!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ……I'll do my best…… in the Selection Race!

――Finally,
the day of the Selection Race was here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Today too,
Trainer-san was planning to give me
signals……)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (But that's too early……! We just started!)
choice_data_list: You can do it! Promising Newcomer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Oooh~, there it is……! Like I thought, 
it's really embarrassing~! But――)
choice_data_list: You can win! You're the best!
You can win! You're the best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I guess it's raising my motivation!)

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Isn't Mirako a little different today? 
She seems a little different from that
training earlier……

text_block_list.name: Cynical Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: Yeah…… you're right. But…… but you know――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haa…… Haa……!

text_block_list.name: Cynical Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: ――Today's Mirako is cool.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Why am I so desperate?
Did I always like running this much?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(If I win this, I'm going to debut, huh? 
Training to be a pro is gonna be tough,
isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I won't be able to go back, after this,
huh? 
Staying up all night reading manga,
I won't be able to 
do things like that anymore, right?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(That person,
I wonder why they're that desperate――)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (……Ahh-, for me)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I guess it's because they have expectations
for me, huh……!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(……I guess I don't need to think about it
too 
hard, huh? After all, I'm happy right now)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(So I can live up to that person's
expectations, 
I guess…… I'll try to work a little
harder!)

Hishi Miracle took first!
I hurriedly rushed through 
the crowd of people in awe at the surprise
victory.
choice_data_list: With this…… we can form a contract!!
With this…… we can form a contract!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
……Fu.
Fufufu…… Ahaha! You don't have to be 
in such a hurry,
I'm not going to run away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
……Well, Trainer-san. You see, 
I don't really think I can devote my life
to racing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's why,
I'll do my best just to 『Live up to those
expectations』. 
……Are you still okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So that I can keep running, always~
……keep those expectations coming.
choice_data_list: Of course. We're gonna win G1s!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
that might be getting a little ahead of
ourselves~. 
Something like that,
we'd probably need a miracle――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ……you sure know what to say.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Aaah~,
I'm just getting swept up in the moment. 
But――)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
……If you're willing to say that much, 
then I'm looking forward to it, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Well……I guess that's fine)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh no~,
I forgot the recyclable trash again…… Ummm,
gather up 
all the cardboard,
I already threw away the magazines……Ah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ……I guess I don't need this anymore.

Hishi Miracle gathered up her college
pamphlets from her 
bookshelf and tied them together with a
string.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright. 
Next up…… guess I'll head to training~!
